title: This EXACT Date in 2026 Will Shift the Entire Market
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Rob Spivey of Altimetry Research on three market-moving themes for 2026, capped by one exact date: May 15, 2026 - when President Trump appoints the new Fed chair. Spivey expects the administration to push rates toward 1-2%, and with consumers at just 15% of S&P 500 market cap (an all-time low) under debt and delinquency pressure, aggressive cuts would act as a 'safety valve' that could spark a violent bounce in beaten-up consumer stocks, similar to healthcare's Q4 2025 rally. Theme one is energy: 'price at the meter is the new price at the pump' - US power prices have surged since 2020 and 80+ GW of new data centers are planned, so the administration must fast-track power plants; his pick is Bowman Consulting (BWMN), an engineering consultancy (not a builder, so no contract risk) whose return on assets could ramp from mid-single digits over a 5-10 year buildout. He cautions nuclear is a 6-10 year story, not two - though he likes Constellation Energy's strategy of selling existing nuclear power directly to hyperscalers and backfilling the grid with new natural gas plants. Theme two: AI pullbacks (like November's ~10% Nasdaq dip) are buying opportunities as long as credit conditions stay healthy - his dollar-cost-averaging model says deploy cash over ~6 months right now. His consumer pick for the May 15 catalyst: Douglas Elliman (DOUG), the real-estate broker, whose returns on assets could jump from ~0% to 10-20%+ if lower rates unfreeze housing turnover. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'Alimemetry'/'Ultim' = Altimetry Research; 'Douglas Element' = Douglas Elliman (DOUG); GE Vernova mentioned only in passing.
